title: On the Spectra of Chromatic Number and Chromatic Index of Cyclic Covers
summary: For a fixed integer $\ell \ge 2$, we study what values of chromatic index and chromatic number can be attained by some $\ell$-fold cyclic cover of a loopless multigraph. For edge-coloring, we first investigate the density, a fundamental lower bound for the chromatic index, and show that the density of every $\ell$-fold cyclic cover of a graph $G$ is at most that of $G$. We further prove that if $\ell$ is even, then the spectrum of chromatic indices over all $\ell$-fold cyclic covers of $G$ contains every integer between $Δ(G)$ and $χ'(G)$.
